41741-bound-to-succeed-or-mail-order-fra.title: Mail Order Frank’s Chances
41741-bound-to-succeed-or-mail-order-fra.creator: Allen Chapman
41741-bound-to-succeed-or-mail-order-fra.description: A book by Allen Chapman. “It’s no use, mother,” he said finally. “The lost fortune is a dream, a bubble. We may just as well get down to that. Beach, the lawyer, gives us hopes, but they are not based on much. At the same time, he takes his fees. We can’t stand that any longer. I told him so, yesterday. I don’t believe there is the least show in the world for our claim. Beach shares my opinion now.

arxiv-1801-03662.title: A value distribution result related to Hayman’s alternative
arxiv-1801-03662.creator: Kuldeep Singh Charak, Anil Singh
arxiv-1801-03662.description: Abstract . Motivated by Bloch’s Principle, we prove a value distribution result for meromorphic functions which is related to Hayman’s alternative in certain sense. † † footnotetext: 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification . 30D35, 30D45. † † footnotetext: Keywords and phrases . Meromorphic function, Value distribution theory, Normal families, Bloch’s principle. 1.

arxiv-2108-03502.title: Fine-tuning GPT-3 for Russian Text Summarization
arxiv-2108-03502.creator: Nikolich Alexandr, Puchkova Arina
arxiv-2108-03502.description: Abstract Automatic summarization techniques aim to shorten and generalize information given in the text while preserving its core message and the most relevant ideas. This task can be approached and treated with a variety of methods, however, not many attempts have been to produce solutions specifically for the Russian language despite existing localizations of the state-of-the-art models.

arxiv-2202-03459.title: Scaling of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm on superconducting qubit based hardware
arxiv-2202-03459.creator: Johannes Weidenfeller, Lucia C. Valor, Julien Gacon, Caroline Tornow, Luciano Bello, Stefan Woerner, Daniel J. Egger
arxiv-2202-03459.description: Abstract Quantum computers may provide good solutions to combinatorial optimization problems by leveraging the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). The QAOA is often presented as an algorithm for noisy hardware. However, hardware constraints limit its applicability to problem instances that closely match the connectivity of the qubits. Furthermore, the QAOA must outpace classical solvers.

arxiv-2204-05402.creator: Alexey V. Ivanov
arxiv-2204-05402.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alexey V. Ivanov. We consider a skew product F A = ( σ ω , A ) F_{A}=(\sigma_{\omega},A) over irrational rotation σ ω ​ ( x ) = x + ω \sigma_{\omega}(x)=x+\omega of a circle 𝕋 1 \mathbb{T}^{1} .

arxiv-2206-09079.title: Aluminum functionalized silicene: a potential anode material for alkali metal ion batteries
arxiv-2206-09079.creator: Bruno Ipaves, João F. Justo, Lucy V. C. Assali
arxiv-2206-09079.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bruno Ipaves, João F. Justo, Lucy V. C. Assali. We have investigated the possibility of using aluminum functionalized silicene trilayers ( ABC − Si 4 ​ Al 2 \text{ABC}{-}\text{Si}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{4}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{4}}\text{}}\text{Al}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}} ) as an anode material for alkali metal ion batteries (AMIBs). First, we studied the thermodynamic stability of ABC − Si 4 ​ Al 2 \text{ABC}{-}\text{Si}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{4}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{4}}\text{}}\text{Al}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{2}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{2}}\text{}} using ab-initio molecular dynamics simulations, showing that this material remains stable up to 600 K.

arxiv-2207-04521.title: Information-Theoretic Bounds for Steganography in Multimedia
arxiv-2207-04521.creator: Hassan Y. El-Arsh, Amr Abdelaziz, Ahmed Elliethy, Hussein A. Aly, and T. Aaron Gulliver
arxiv-2207-04521.description: Abstract Steganography in multimedia aims to embed secret data into an innocent looking multimedia cover object. This embedding introduces some distortion to the cover object and produces a corresponding stego object. The embedding distortion is measured by a cost function that determines the detection probability of the existence of the embedded secret data.

arxiv-2211-06166.title: Mathematical modeling of Neuroblast Migration towards the Olfactory Bulb
arxiv-2211-06166.creator: Daniel Acosta-Soba, Carmen Castro, Noelia Geribaldi-Doldán, Francisco Guillén-González, Pedro Nunez-Abades, Noelia Ortega-Román, Patricia Pérez-García, J. Rafael Rodríguez-Galván
arxiv-2211-06166.description: Abstract This article is devoted to the mathematical modeling of migration of neuroblasts, precursor cells of neurons, along the pathway they usually follow before maturing. This pathway is determined mainly by attraction forces, to the olfactory bulb, and the heterogeneous mobility of neuroblasts in different regions of the brain.

arxiv-2305-09253.title: Online Continual Learning Without the Storage Constraint
arxiv-2305-09253.creator: Ameya Prabhu, Zhipeng Cai, Puneet Dokania, Philip Torr, Vladlen Koltun, Ozan Sener
arxiv-2305-09253.description: Abstract Traditional online continual learning (OCL) research has primarily focused on mitigating catastrophic forgetting with fixed and limited storage allocation throughout an agent’s lifetime. However, a broad range of real-world applications are primarily constrained by computational costs rather than storage limitations.

arxiv-2305-12756.title: Fair Allocation in Crowd-Sourced Systems
arxiv-2305-12756.creator: Mishal Assif P K, William Kennedy, Iraj Saniee
arxiv-2305-12756.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mishal Assif P K, William Kennedy, Iraj Saniee. In this paper, we address the problem of fair sharing of the total value of a crowd-sourced network system between major participants (founders) and minor participants (crowd) using cooperative game theory. Shapley allocation is regarded as a fair way for computing the shares of all participants in a cooperative game when the values of all possible coalitions could be quantified.

arxiv-2308-07463.creator: Ali Enayat
arxiv-2308-07463.description: Abstract . We present two new constructions of satisfaction/truth classes over models of 𝖯𝖠 \mathsf{PA} (Peano Arithmetic) that provide a foil to the fact that the existence of a disjunctively correct full truth class over a model ℳ \mathcal{M} of 𝖯𝖠 \mathsf{PA} implies that ℳ \mathcal{M} satisfies 𝖢𝗈𝗇 ⁡ ( 𝖯𝖠 ) \mathsf{Con}(\mathsf{PA}) .

arxiv-2401-11682.title: Entangled biphoton generation in myelin sheath
arxiv-2401-11682.creator: Zefei Liu, Yong-Cong Chen, Ping Ao
arxiv-2401-11682.description: Abstract Consciousness within the brain hinges on the synchronized activities of millions of neurons, but the mechanism responsible for orchestrating such synchronization remains elusive. In this study, we employ cavity quantum electrodynamics (cQED) to explore entangled biphoton generation through cascade emission in the vibration spectrum of C-H bonds within the lipid molecules’ tails.

arxiv-2404-16347.title: Enhancing Arterial Blood Flow Simulations through Physics-Informed Neural Networks
arxiv-2404-16347.creator: Shivam Bhargava, Nagaiah Chamakuri
arxiv-2404-16347.description: Abstract This study introduces a computational approach leveraging Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for the efficient computation of arterial blood flows, particularly focusing on solving the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations by using the domain decomposition technique. Unlike conventional computational fluid dynamics methods, PINNs offer advantages by eliminating the need for discretized meshes and enabling the direct solution of partial differential equations (PDEs).

arxiv-2407-00538.title: Privacy-Preserving and Trustworthy Deep Learning for Medical Imaging Thanks: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible.
arxiv-2407-00538.creator: Kiarash Sedghighadikolaei, Attila A Yavuz
arxiv-2407-00538.description: Abstract The shift towards efficient and automated data analysis through Machine Learning (ML) has notably impacted healthcare systems, particularly Radiomics. Radiomics leverages ML to analyze medical images accurately and efficiently for precision medicine. Current methods rely on Deep Learning (DL) to improve performance and accuracy (Deep Radiomics).

arxiv-2502-05366.title: An effective estimation of multivariate density functions using extended-beta kernels with Bayesian adaptive bandwidths Thanks: Université de Bangui, Laboratoire de mathématiques et connexes de Bangui, BP 908 Bangui, Centrafrique. libengue@gmail.com
arxiv-2502-05366.creator: Sobom M. Somé, Célestin C. Kokonendji
arxiv-2502-05366.description: Abstract Multivariate kernel density estimations have received much spate of interest. In addition to conventional methods of (non-)classical associated-kernels for (un)bounded densities and bandwidth selections, the multiple extended-beta kernel (MEBK) estimators with Bayesian adaptive bandwidths are invested to gain a deeper and better insight into the estimation of multivariate density functions.

pmc-10647075.title: Multi-electrolyte disturbance and supplementation in severely malnourished hospitalized adolescents with restrictive eating disorders
pmc-10647075.creator: Eva-Molly Petitto Dunbar, Chase Pribble, Jennifer Cueto, Andrea B. Goldschmidt, Christina Tortolani, Abigail A. Donaldson
pmc-10647075.description: BackgroundThis study describes the prevalence of hypophosphatemia, hypokalemia, and/or hypomagnesemia and resulting electrolyte supplementation during refeeding in severely malnourished youths hospitalized for restrictive eating disorders.MethodsHospitalized patients between 11-26y (N = 81) at < 75% treatment goal weight (TGW) were assessed through retrospective chart review. Outcomes were compared between participants < 70% TGW and those 70–75% TGW.

pmc-11358002.title: Empagliflozin effects on iron metabolism as a possible mechanism for improved clinical outcomes in non-diabetic patients with systolic heart failure
pmc-11358002.creator: Christiane E Angermann, Carlos G Santos-Gallego, Juan Antonio Requena-Ibanez, Susanne Sehner, Tanja Zeller, Louisa M S Gerhardt, Christoph Maack, Javier Sanz, Stefan Frantz, Valentin Fuster, Georg Ertl, Juan J Badimon
pmc-11358002.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors improve clinical outcomes in patients with heart failure (HF), but mechanisms of action are incompletely understood. In the EMPA-TROPISM trial, empagliflozin reversed cardiac remodeling and increased physical capacity in stable non-diabetic patients with systolic HF. Here we explore, post hoc, whether treatment effects in this cohort, comprising patients who had a high prevalence of iron deficiency, were related to iron metabolism.

pmc-11431752.title: Pasta Incorporating Olive Pomace: Impact on Nutritional Composition and Consumer Acceptance of a Prototype
pmc-11431752.creator: Diana Melo Ferreira, Bárbara C. C. Oliveira, Carla Barbosa, Anabela S. G. Costa, Maria Antónia Nunes, Maria Beatriz P. P. Oliveira, Rita C. Alves
pmc-11431752.description: The food industry is encouraged to develop new sustainable foodstuffs, and agri-food by-products can serve as valuable ingredients in these formulations. In this work, olive pomace (OP), a by-product of olive oil production, was incorporated as an ingredient in pasta. The changes in the nutritional composition and consumer acceptance were assessed, aiming to scale up the production.

pmc-11547729.title: Deformation Performance of Longitudinal Non-Uniformly Corroded Reinforced Concrete Columns
pmc-11547729.creator: Guoyao Sun, Huanjun Jiang, Vit Smilauer
pmc-11547729.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Due to the complexity of the marine corrosive environment, the rebar corrosion in reinforced concrete (RC) bridge piers is usually longitudinal non-uniform. However, the study on the mechanical behavior of longitudinal non-uniformly corroded RC structural members is very limited. To systematically study the deformation performance of the longitudinal non-uniformly corroded RC columns, the finite element models of 106 RC columns with different parameters were established using the commercial software ABAQUS 2016.

pmc-12672442.title: Knowledge and perception of otosclerosis among women in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12672442.creator: Reem Elbeltagy, Shahad Aljwayed, Seham Almutairi, Ghadi Alharbi, Layan Alanzi, Lila Almukhlifi, Rania Alkahtani
pmc-12672442.description: BackgroundOtosclerosis is a bone disease of the ear that primarily affects women and can lead to progressive hearing loss. Delays in diagnosis and treatment may occur due to limited awareness of the condition. This study aimed to assess the level of knowledge and perception of otosclerosis among women in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12712025.title: Assessment of hepatic steatosis during rat liver regeneration after 70% partial hepatectomy using stereology and MRI-PDFF
pmc-12712025.creator: Andrea Lund, Uffe Kjaergaard, Lotte Bertelsen, Esben Søvsø Hansen, Katrine Holm Andersen, Steffen Ringgaard, Jens Randel Nyengaard, Christoffer Laustsen, Frank Viborg Mortensen
pmc-12712025.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Partial hepatectomy (PH) is the primary treatment for liver malignancies, leveraging the liver’s regenerative capacity and metabolic potential. Transient hepatic steatosis is a common occurrence following PH. This study aimed to evaluate the utility of MRI-derived proton density fat fraction (MRI-PDFF) for assessing hepatic lipid content in the regenerating rat liver by correlating it with stereological lipid quantification, used as a histological reference standard.

pmc-12837083.title: Rethinking the bodily self: evidence from the enfacement illusion in women at risk for eating disorders
pmc-12837083.creator: Jade Portingale, Isabel Krug, Tamsyn E Van Rheenen, Litza Kiropoulos, Cali F Bartholomeusz, Helen Nasser, David Butler
pmc-12837083.description: BackgroundBodily illusion research has demonstrated that altered bodily-self-perception in eating disorders (EDs) may be linked to abnormalities in the integration of sensory bodily signals. Experiencing bodily illusions can also temporarily reduce body image disturbance. Whether similar alterations in multisensory integration processes extend to self-face representation and whether face-based multisensory illusions can reduce face or body image disturbance remains unclear.

pmc-13290425.title: Ladder‐Like Structural Architecture of Layered Magnetic A 2.4 Cr8Te14 (A = Rb, Cs) Compounds by Self‐Flux Synthesis
pmc-13290425.creator: Kai D Röseler, Felix Eder, Fabian O von Rohr
pmc-13290425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The discovery and control of intergrowth structures represent an important avenue for the targeted synthesis of new, more complex structure types. When including magnetic framework metal atoms, this enhanced complexity can transfer to rich magnetic ground states. Here, we show that the subtle adjustment of the composition of alkali–tellurium fluxes enables the synthesis of a new family of alkali chromium tellurides, A 2.4 Cr8Te14 (A = Rb, Cs).
